title: Argentinian Beef Wrap mit Garlicky Sauerkraut
description: A flavorful German-inspired wrap filled with marinated Argentinian beef, garlicky sauerkraut, and wrapped in a unique tortilla.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced Argentinian beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut and stir to combine. Cook until the sauerkraut is slightly caramelized, about 2-3 minutes.
Season the beef and sauerkraut mixture with salt and black pepper.
Warm the unique tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the beef and sauerkraut mixture onto each tortilla.
Optional: serve with a side of spicy mustard or a dollop of sour cream for added flavor.
